analogy.rationale: SRC inhibitors are ATP-competitive tyrosine kinase inhibitors, so other tyrosine kinase inhibitors (especially broad-spectrum ones) should share downstream signaling effects; however, SRC-family kinases are broadly expressed and only partially redundant, so the transcriptional response is expected to be weak-to-moderate and most similar to other tyrosine kinase inhibitors.
